mechanism: Zoledronic acid can cause electrolyte disturbances (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and QT prolongation risk, while propafenone is a Class IC antiarrhythmic that can also prolong QT interval and is sensitive to electrolyte abnormalities affecting cardiac conduction.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, potassium) closely, obtain baseline and periodic ECG monitoring, and ensure adequate supplementation of electrolytes during zoledronic acid therapy.
